content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DHS Lakshadweep Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DHS Lakshadweep to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHS Lakshadweep recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the various posts under the Directorate of Health Services Lakshadweep is 18 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies available for various healthcare positions, including Nursing Officer, Nursing Assistant, Biomed Engineer, and Lab Technician.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application process for DHS Lakshadweep recruitment is entirely online. Candidates must submit their details via the provided Google Form link before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the DHS Lakshadweep recruitment process.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection of the candidates for the advertised posts will be based on an interview process conducted by the Directorate of Health Services Lakshadweep.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Nursing Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Nursing Officer position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 12,600/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for a Lab Technician?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Plus Two Science group and possess a B.Sc. or Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technician course from a recognized institute.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the recruitment for these positions is on a contract basis under the Directorate of Health Services, Lakshadweep.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from other states apply?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications from eligible candidates. Interested individuals meeting the educational criteria are encouraged to apply through the official link provided.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification details and the application link are available on the official website or the provided link in the important links section of this article.
